method.quantiles: Hyndman/Fan type 7 (linear interpolation between sorted sample ranks)
method.cpu_percent_one_core: 100% equals one logical CPU; may exceed 100%
method.cpu_percent_machine: Normalized by collector Environment.ProcessorCount; see monitor metadata
method.memory_unit: MiB = 1048576 bytes; RSS is working set, private is committed private bytes
method.gpu: Own phase must match, transition false, collection start after warmup; unique (session_id, observed_utc)
method.gpu_engine_percent: Busiest engine preferred; engine sums may exceed 100% and are not total GPU utilization
method.io: Process I/O includes cached/non-disk I/O; not physical disk throughput
method.stale_baseline_rule: Exclude ambient_main_before_test_audio samples at or after playback start

evidence_type: sanitized scalar trace with reproducible aggregates
